story.zh: 汉帝在位期间，或在英雄集结剧本中，每年一月都会在帝都举办一次全国大会。按时年分别举办比武大会，群武大会（三对三武斗），辩论大会，以及群辩大会（三对三舌战），和演兵大会（四对四战棋）。每五年一轮回，获胜者将获得丰厚的回报！
story.en: During the reign of the Han Emperor, or in the A Gathering of Heroes Scenario, a nationwide tournament is held every January in the imperial capital. Each year hosts a different event in turn: the Martial Tournament, Melee Tournament (3v3 Combat), Debate Tournament, Group Debate Tournament (3v3 Debate), or Tactical Drill Tournament (4v4 Tactical Chess). Cycling every five years, victors will receive lavish rewards!

participate.zh: 每年一月前往京师（汉帝所在地）参加大会。
participate.en: Travel to the capital (where the Han Emperor resides) in January each year to attend the tournament.
